tagline: Kadıköy's quieter, more charming neighbour — waterfront promenades, independent bookshops, and some of the city's finest pastries.

items.name: Moda İskele Café
items.description: Right on the waterfront with sweeping Bosphorus views. The perfect place for a morning coffee watching the ferries pass.
items.tip: Come at sunrise or sunset — the light on the water is extraordinary.

items.name: Vanilla Kasımpaşa Pastanesi
items.description: A beloved local pastry shop with exceptional cakes, pastries, and Turkish sweets. Entirely unpretentious and delicious.

items.name: Espressolab Moda
items.description: One of Istanbul's best specialty coffee chains, with a calm Moda branch perfect for working or reading.

items.name: Moda'da Balık
items.description: Excellent fresh fish restaurant loved by locals. Simple mezes, perfectly grilled fish, and good rakı. Book ahead.
items.tip: Ask for the catch of the day rather than ordering from the menu — always better and fresher.

items.name: Kalamış Sahili Restoranları
items.description: A cluster of waterfront restaurants in nearby Kalamış with Bosphorus views. Good for a long, relaxed dinner.

items.name: Çorbacı Abi
items.description: The best soup spot in Moda. Open until late — a neighbourhood institution for lentil soup and bread at any hour.
items.tip: The mercimek çorbası (red lentil soup) with a squeeze of lemon is a must after a long evening.

items.name: Moda Promenade Walk
items.description: A beautiful seafront promenade stretching along the Moda coastline. Perfect for morning runs, evening strolls, and watching the Bosphorus traffic.

items.name: Secondhand Bookshops
items.description: Moda has an impressive cluster of independent secondhand bookshops. A slow browse on a weekend afternoon is one of the neighbourhood's great pleasures.

items.name: Moda Park
items.description: A leafy park beloved by locals, dog walkers, and picnickers. Great on weekends when the neighbourhood comes alive.

tips: Moda is a 15-minute walk from Kadıköy main square or a short dolmuş ride.
The waterfront is best in the morning before the weekend crowds arrive.
Moda's bookshops are all secondhand — bring cash and set aside time to browse properly.
The neighbourhood has a very local, residential feel compared to central Kadıköy. That's the point.
